We strongly advise against enjoying this game within the hallowed halls of a church or any other place of worship.

--- --- --- --- 

Over the Moon

They say time heals all wounds, but for you and Moon, time has only sharpened the edges of a bitter separation. Now a celebrated musician bound to a diabolical record label, Moon is being forced to face the person she swore to leave behind forever:

You.

Her label, Salacia, sees your reluctance to make a second season of your successful television show as a bargaining chip. They want to strong-arm you into working on Season 2 of Madds Medusa so they can cozy up to Oberon, a growing streaming platform that you signed with. You agree to go to China where Moon is currently touring. Caught in a twisted game of corporate blackmail, you decide to use the opportunity to convince Moon to finally come home. 

In the powerful conclusion of The Rose Garden Trilogy, you must confront the wreckage of your past. The last two years have been a sexual journey of exploration and excitement, but also of frustration and loss. Will you be able to control your rampaging libido when confronted with a maddeningly gorgeous pop star, a cute pizza delivery girl, and your old flame Nixie? Or will your desires show Moon the true nature of the man that you've become?
